## Identity & Core Positioning

Marian Stancik is an AI Engineer, UAV Systems Builder, and Law Scholar exploring the convergence of artificial intelligence, autonomous physical hardware, and regulatory compliance.

His core differentiation is the intersection of three domains:
1. **Autonomous AI Systems:** Hermes Agent, MCP tooling, OpenRouter model orchestration, Hetzner VPS 24/7 runtime, Obsidian second brain / memory layer, zero-build web engineering.
2. **Law & AI Compliance:** Practical legal-by-design frameworks under the EU AI Act, GDPR, NIS2, DORA, EU Data Act, and DSM Copyright Directive (TDM exceptions).
3. **UAV Systems & Edge Robotics:** Hand-soldered 1500g carbon quad, Betaflight tested, ArduPilot Copter autopilot, Raspberry Pi 5 edge vision AI, EASA A1/A3 certified, €2.6M insured.

## Core Pillars & Detailed Technical Architecture

### 1. AI Engineering & Autonomous Systems
- **Agent Frameworks:** Hermes Agent (Nous Research), custom MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers, Python agent skills.
- **Production Infrastructure:** Enterprise European Hetzner Cloud VPS (Nuremberg/Helsinki), running 19+ cron-orchestrated agents 24/7 with zero downtime and full EU data sovereignty.
- **Model Orchestration:** OpenRouter API for dynamic model routing (DeepSeek V3/R1, Claude 3.5 Sonnet, GPT-4o, Llama 3.3).
- **Memory & Second Brain:** Obsidian Markdown vault acting as a persistent memory layer and structured knowledge base for agent workflows.
- **Command & Control (C2):** Real-time management via custom Telegram & WhatsApp bot interfaces.
- **Web Engineering:** Zero-build HTML5, Vanilla JS, and modern CSS for instant loading (Lighthouse 100) and GEO/LLMO discovery.

### 2. Law & AI Compliance
- Specialization in legal and business impacts of AI on companies, digital services, and enterprise governance.
- **EU AI Act:** Risk classification (unacceptable, high, GPAI, minimal), transparency obligations, prohibited practices, and technical documentation.
- **GDPR:** Training data privacy, legal bases for processing, automated decision-making (Art. 22), and data subject rights.
- **NIS2 Directive:** Cybersecurity risk management, supply chain security, and incident reporting for digital providers.
- **DORA:** Digital operational resilience for financial entities utilizing AI and cloud infrastructure.
- **EU Data Act & Data Governance Act:** Data access, cloud switching, and European data sovereignty.
- **DSM Copyright Directive:** Text & Data Mining (TDM) exceptions (Articles 3 & 4) for AI training.

### 3. UAV Systems & Edge Robotics
- **Hardware Build:** 1500g custom 8-inch carbon quadcopter, hand-soldered and assembled from bare components.
- **Frame & Motors:** GEPRC Mark4-8 Carbon Frame, iFlight XING2 2809 1250Kv motors, HQprop 8" triblades, GNB 5500mAh 6S 70C LiPo.
- **Electronics & Autopilot:** Skystars H7 Dual Gyro FC, AM60 AM32 60A ESC stack, RadioMaster XR1 Nano ELRS, FlyfishRC M10QMC-5883L GNSS + Compass.
- **Flight Software:** Flight-tested initially on Betaflight, migrated to ArduPilot Copter for autonomous waypoint navigation and mission scripting.
- **Edge AI Companion:** Raspberry Pi 5 (8GB RAM), Raspberry Pi Camera Module 3, dedicated 5V/5A BEC, running onboard computer vision models for real-time target detection and tracking.
- **FPV Transmission:** Caddx Ratel 2 Micro, Axisflying Smurfs 1.6W 5.8GHz VTX, Foxeer Lollipop 4 Plus, Skyzone Cobra X V4 goggles.
- **Certification & Insurance:** Certified EASA A1/A3 pilot, Coverdrone €2.6M liability insurance.
